The listed boilerplate sections are standard institutional policies found verbatim across many university syllabi. The text cleanups address bullet points that should be continuations of previous text or sub-items, and a malformed bullet character that needs standardization. For the first three text_cleanups, the proposed fix is to replace the literal string (including the leading newline and bullet) with just the text, effectively merging it with the preceding content.
